newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Jordan's King Hussein visits Dublin.
newsitem.headline: Jordan's King Hussein visits Dublin.

text.p: King Hussein of Jordan arrived on an official visit to Dublin on Wednesday for bilateral consultations with Irish Prime minister John Bruton and Deputy prime minister Dick Spring, government sources said.
King Hussein was greeted at Dublin airport by Prime minister Bruton and Princess Haya, the first child of the King and his third wife, the late Queen Alia.

Princess Haya, who came to Ireland 18-months ago to train at showjumper Paul Darragh's Waterside stud in eastern Ireland, accompanied the King to President Mary Robinson's residence, Aras an Uachtarain, for a tree-planting ceremony.
The princess is expected to remain in Ireland until 2000 when she hopes to compete at the Sydney Olympics.
King Hussein is scheduled to meet with Bruton and Spring at 1700 GMT and will attend a dinner in his honour.
